blocks.text: Unit testing program ke alag alag hisson (units), jaise akele functions, ko test karna hai taake har hissa sahi kaam kare. Is se ghaltiyan jaldi pakri jati hain aur debugging aasan ho jati hai. Python tests likhne aur chalane ke liye unittest aur pytest jaise modules deta hai. Yeh modules functions aur methods ki testing khud-kaar (automated) kar dete hain. Unit tests jaanchte hain ke har hissa (component) wahi output deta hai jis ki tawaqqo (expected output) hai. Saaf aur saada test cases likhne se code par bharosa barhta hai.

items: Unit testing: program ke chhote hisse (functions) alag alag jaanchna.
